paper_title: SimSMoE Solving Representational Collapse via Similarity Measure
caption: : SMoE Routing Policy
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the validation performance of two models, SMOE and SimSMoE, over a series of training steps, with performance measured by the BPC metric on the y-axis, which ranges from 1.2 to 2.2, and training steps on the x-axis, which ranges from 0 to 50 thousand (x10³). The x-axis is labeled “Training Steps (x10³)” and uses a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 10 thousand steps (0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50). The y-axis is labeled “BPC” and also uses a linear scale. The plot contains two lines: the SMOE Validating line is black with solid lines and 'x' markers, while the SimSMoE Validating line is magenta with solid lines and '•' markers. Both lines begin at a BPC value of approximately 2.2 at training step 0. The SMOE line exhibits a steep initial decline, falling from 2.2 to around 1.2 by step 20, after which it stabilizes near 1.2. The SimSMoE line follows a similar trajectory, starting at 2.2 and declining to approximately 1.2 by step 20, then also stabilizing near 1.2. The two lines remain very close to each other after step 20, with the SimSMoE line slightly below the SMOE line in the final portion of the plot.
